references.text: God promised to free Israel from Egypt and lead them to a land flowing with milk and honey - this is the promise fulfilled in Judges 6:9
Describes God's deliverance of Israel from the hand of the Egyptians and their oppressors
God promised to drive out the Canaanites before Israel and give them the land
Moses reminds Israel that the Lord brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
Joshua reminds the people that God gave them a land they had not worked for and drove out nations before them
The psalmist confesses that it was God's hand that drove out the nations and planted Israel in the land
God drove out the nations before Israel and let them dwell in their tents
Nehemiah confesses that God saved Israel from the hand of their enemies repeatedly
Stephen speaks about how God drove out the nations before the fathers when they entered the land
Paul summarizes God's deliverance from Egypt and his driving out of the nations in Canaan
